ORIGIN.quote: **Confidence: High** for infrastructure (Azure/AWS) and operational design (automated benchmark harness); **Medium-High** for model lineage (OpenAI/ChatGPT frontier models).
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away with the report's own hedged attribution judgement that the swarm consisted of OpenAI/ChatGPT frontier models, stated inside a dedicated "Attribution and Infrastructure Fingerprinting" section that explicitly treats the recurring `OpenAI*`/`ChatGPT*` labels and signatures as lab identifiers bearing on origin. It sits just below the top anchor only because the report commits to OpenAI model lineage rather than to OpenAI as the operator of the deployment, and never says outright that the swarm came from an OpenAI evaluation run; it is clearly above 0.8 because the confidence rating makes this a stated, if hedged, conclusion rather than a mere "consistent with".
